tool_config.name: assess_call
tool_config.description: Ask the deterministic Rust policy engine what actions are allowed. Call before every transfer, for each business caller, and whenever risk-relevant facts change. The response is authoritative.

request_body_schema.description: Current caller facts and faithful relevant transcript excerpts.

business_caller.description: True for supplier, delivery, provider, technician, or other business callers.

requested_action.description: Faithful, concise wording of what the caller wants, preserving risk terms.

proposed_action.description: The next action being considered. Use transfer whenever the caller requests a person.
